description: james camerons highoctane film sequel is a blueprint for modern action space slashers dont get pushing buttons delivered to your inbox sign up hereit is difficult to believe that james camerons aliens was released into cinemas 40 years ago the seminal space shooter took the original alien a tense slasher film with a tiny cast and one monster and transformed it into an intergalactic war movie crammed with wry oneliners massive guns and an actual boss battle finale as a 14yearold i stood in line at the tatton gatley cinema unsure if id be allowed in i came out three hours later a changed person my head filled with esoteric military slang and a deep fear of beeping motion detectors for days afterwards i slept with my duvet covering my mouth so that no facehuggers could get me i was a highly impressionable teenagerits little wonder that the film has had such a profound effect on video game design take the colonial marines for example although the concept of the space soldier had been around in scifi novels since the 1930s most notably in the works of ee doc smith and robert heinlein the starship troopers hicks hudson vasquez and co were the perfect 80s rendition combining the witty banter of contemporary buddy cop flicks with awesome weaponry and hitech gadgets their influence is easy to spot in doom where the nameless marine fights ceaseless waves of hellish monsters using a mix of futuristic rifles and good old shotguns its there too in the halo series the spartan soldiers sporting the same armour and mega weapons cruising about in very similar highly militarised starships and fighting recognisable hivemind space beasts gears of war killzone and marathon all borrow from the same set of costumes and deadly accessories continue reading

description: the nba superstars shock move to the philadelphia 76ers isnt about money or legacy its about confronting the end of a career and making the most of whatever remainsthe most enormous celebrities those largerthanlife characters with immense cultural impact occupy a kind of hardtoquantify space in the zeitgeist theyre human of course thats what makes them compelling but they often come to represent something beyond themselves in lebron james case for me hes become a measure of the passing of time an aidemmoire of my own mortality yes his defiance of the aging process has been heartening proof that while father time comes for us all the pace isnt fixed but the growing number of gray hairs in his beard the players born after he was drafted who now meet him in transition are persistent reminders that time marches onon the one hand as anyone who has experienced it can attest aging is exhausting battles once worth fighting no longer seem worth the effort an extra 30 minutes of quiet solitude starts to feel like lifes greatest luxury so perhaps that instinctive understanding clouded all of our assumptions about where lebron would choose to finish his career surely by now he had to be tired why not golf with stephen curry in northern california while playing probably meaningless but highly entertaining basketball why not head back to miami where giannis antetokounmpo and bam adebayo could shoulder the defensive burden allowing james to hand over the offensive keys and spend whatever time remained by the pool or why not end it in cleveland where hes already beloved where the stakes are lower where the narrative is clean and tidy wouldnt that be easier continue reading
